# Head of Security (HOS) SOP
This is the list of procedures, responsibilities, and duties of the [color=#1b67a5][bold]Head of Security[/bold][/color] of this station.
For the purposes of Alert Escalation: Treat higher alerts as if they are still on the previous alert level. (Yellow Alert is Blue Alert if it was Blue Alert prior.) Furthermore, treat Delta, Gamma, Epsilon, and Violet Alert as Red Alert.
## Green Alert
1. The Head of Security is permitted to carry out arrests under the same conditions as their [color=#ba292c][bold]Security Officers[/bold][/color]. They are expected to patrol and may not idle in security for extended periods of time.
2. The Head of Security is permitted to carry a standard disabler, one flash, one flashbang, and their chosen service weapon(s) from their weapon selector(s). No other gear is permitted. While permitted to carry their unique service weapon(s), all standard escalation protocol is to met while on [color=#388c34]Green Alert[/color]. Lethals are [bold]ONLY[/bold] permitted in very extreme circumstances, which is incredibly unlikely on [color=#388c34]Green Alert[/color].
3. The Head of Security is permitted to have the [color=#1b67a5][bold]Captain[/bold][/color]'s spare ID should the Captain wish, but this card must be labeled “EMERGENCY ACCESS” and kept inside the Head of Security’s locker unless circumstances escalate to a higher alert level.
4. The Head of Security is not obligated to provide a legal trial but should allow legal representation for Capital Crimes if the suspect requests it.
5. The Head of Security may not overrule the Captain unless the Captain's decisions blatantly break Standard Operating Procedure and/or Space Law. If so, Central Command is to be contacted as well.
6. The Head of Security must follow the same guidelines as the [color=#ba292c][bold]Warden[/bold][/color] for Armory equipment, portable flashers, and deployable barriers.
7. The Head of Security is not permitted to collect equipment from the Armory to carry on their person unless absolutely required due to a station-ending threat.
8. The Head of Security is permitted to wear any clothing provided by Nanotrasen at the beginning of their shift. However, they still must be easily visually identifiable as the Head of Security.
9. The Parade Hardsuit as well as similar hardsuits may not be worn on [color=#388c34]Green Alert[/color]. Modsuits may be worn strictly for storage purposes, and they may not be deployed unless circumstances require this beyond a reasonable doubt.
10. The Head of Security may not overrule established sentences unless further evidence is brought to light or the prisoner in question attempts to escape.
## Blue Alert 1. All Guidelines except Guideline 2 carry over from [color=#388c34]Green Alert[/color].
2. The Head of Security is permitted to use their service weapon(s) lethally for self-defense purposes and to acquire additional non-Armory equipment. They must follow the same escalation laws for hostiles, and the requirement for lethal force must be met beyond a reasonable doubt.
3. The Head of Security is expected to provide a short briefing on current known threats and what steps are required to safely neutralize said threat. This can either be done vocally on radio or, ideally, be done in person. Briefing should take no longer than five (5) minutes.
4. The Head of Security may use the EMERGENCY ACCESS card, provided the situation requires its use beyond a reasonable doubt.
## Red Alert 1. All Guidelines carry over from [color=#388c34]Green Alert[/color] and [color=#1b67a5]Blue Alert[/color].
2. The Head of Security is required to make a Station Announcement regarding the nature of the confirmed threat that caused [color=#ba292c]Red Alert[/color]. The Captain may perform this duty in the place of the Head of Security.
3. The Head of Security may carry a weapon from the Armory, provided their unique service weapon is either safely stored or is lost.
4. If the nature of the threat involves the onboard Nuclear Fission Explosive, the Head of Security must coordinate to defend the Captain and/or the Nuclear Authentication Disk.
